title: Namespace import shadow traversal
invariant: Shadow traversal survives an import clause with no default name and continues into the namespace import.
scope: The findShadow AST and direct scan invocation for an import clause with no default name. The model assumes earlier scan steps succeed and does not prove JavaScript semantics, downstream analysis, or correctness for other source shapes. Unsupported shapes are unresolved.
